endpoints.truth_yaml:
post_workspaces_approval_requests:
  operationId: submitForApproval
  summary: Submit timesheet entries for approval
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-010000-post.workspaces.approval-requests-dry-run.json
  x-notes: |
    Tool clockify_approvals_submit (internal name clockify_submit_for_approval) uses
    POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/approval-requests via postApprovalPeriod() in
    internal/tools/approvals.go line 167. dry_run probe returned ok:true with payload
    {period:WEEKLY, periodStart:2026-05-11T00:00:00.000Z}. GET on this path returns
    HTTP 200 with the existing approval-requests list (confirming path is live).
    Both specs agree. No discrepancies.
  x-truth-iter: iter17
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Approval request submitted or updated
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED: tool dry_run returned ok:true; GET on path returns 200 (list endpoint shares path). Source confirmed in approvals.go:167. Both specs agree.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post_workspaces_approval_requests_resubmit_entries_for_approval:
  operationId: resubmitEntriesForApproval
  summary: Resubmit rejected or withdrawn entries for approval
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-010000-post.workspaces.approval-requests.resubmit-entries-for-approval-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    GET returns 405 confirming path registration. POST with dummy body returns HTTP 400
    with code 501 and message 'Cannot resubmit entries for user ... as there is no
    active approval request for period ...', confirming the endpoint is live and
    processes requests. Tool clockify_approvals_resubmit uses this path via
    resubmitForApproval → postApprovalPeriod in approvals.go line 171 with
    parts=[approval-requests, resubmit-entries-for-approval]. raw_allowlist_gen.go
    also lists this route. Both specs agree. No discrepancies.
  x-truth-iter: iter17
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Entries resubmitted for approval
    '400':
      description: No active approval request for the given period
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED: POST returns 400 with business-logic error (not 404/405), proving path is live. GET returns 405 confirming route registration. Source confirmed in approvals.go:171.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
post_workspaces_approval_requests_users:
  operationId: submitUserEntriesForApproval
  summary: Submit a specific user's timesheet entries for approval
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521-010000-post.workspaces.approval-requests.users-path-probe.json
  x-notes: |
    POST probe returned HTTP 201 and created a live approval request
    (id=<redacted-id:ebeee2a837>) for the current user acting as both submitter and
    target. The created approval was immediately withdrawn via PATCH
    /approval-requests/{id} with state=WITHDRAWN_SUBMISSION (HTTP 200 cleanup).
    GET on this path returns 405 confirming route registration. Tool
    clockify_submit_for_user_approval (in approvals.go:submitForUserApproval)
    uses this path via postUserApprovalPeriod with parts=[approval-requests, users].
    raw_allowlist_gen.go lists this route. Both specs agree. No discrepancies.
  x-truth-iter: iter17
  responses:
    '201':
      description: Approval request created for the specified user
endpoints.notes: LIVE-VERIFIED: POST returned 201 with full approval object (id=<redacted-id:ebeee2a837>). Created approval immediately withdrawn (PATCH → 200) for cleanup. Source confirmed in approvals.go:submitForUserApproval.
